classification.summary: Each MetaPoint per-user contract exposes an approve() that grants an unlimited POT allowance to whoever calls it, so the attacker called it on every user contract and transferFrom-ed their POT away.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: onchain review: MetaPoint user contract 0x724DbEA8A0ec7070de448ef4AF3b95210BDC8DF6 (the first of eleven drained in the PoC) created 2023-04-09T11:53:44Z by 0xe56d3acbcdbe499400798e3e4bd129a82479a8bc, unrelated to attack sender 0x0d1969a30bb4ba02e731862edbced5f5abba8373; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. The paired withdraw transaction 0x41853747231dcf01017cf419e6e4aa86757e59479964bafdce0921d3e616cc67 moved 27,392.56 USDT out of the POT/USDT pool for 83.86 WBNB; lossUsd converts the 2,500 BNB reported for the whole incident: 2,500 BNB x $324.71 at incidentTimestamp 1681245179 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $811,775.
